name: sg-git-graph
description: Interactive branch and commit graph visualiser. Pure SVG rendering, no external dependencies. Phase 1: static JSON data source. Supports branches, merges, abandoned branches, click-to-inspect commits.

dataFormat.commits: Array of { id, branch, message, author?, timestamp?, parents[], merge?, branchPoint?, abandoned? }

attributes.graph: JSON string of { branches, commits } — loaded on connectedCallback

emits: sg-git-graph:commit-selected — { commit } — user clicked a node

api.setGraph: Load graph from JS object { branches, commits }
api.loadUrl: Fetch JSON from URL and load (returns Promise)
api.getSelected: Returns currently selected commit or null

futurePhases.2: Live SGit vault data source via structure key
futurePhases.3: Programmatic API for real-time LLM thread visualisation
